en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a railway station and the town beyond. In the foreground a steam train with freight wagons stands at the station platforms beside multi‑storey houses. Further back are church towers and larger institutional or castle‑like buildings on a gentle hillside, with rural fields in the distance. The caption in red German text along the bottom names the town and describes the view.
